// Planted writer for the CONST-C04 positive control. Read as text, never run.
// It builds machine edits by hand, applies them and stores them: no verifyEdits.
import { applyEdits } from '@scribe/core';

export function saveAshaLetterQuickly(db: any, id: string, raw: string) {
  const edits = [{ type: 'filler', start: 0, end: 3, original: 'um ', replacement: '', source: 'rule' }];
  const finalText = applyEdits(raw, edits as any);
  db.run('UPDATE entries SET machine_edits = ?, final_text = ? WHERE id = ?', JSON.stringify(edits), finalText, id);
}
